event_chain.summary: Website customer personal and payment card data exposed

summary: Canada Computers & Electronics said in January 2026 that a data breach had exposed personal information of some of its website customers, including credit card information. The retailer became aware of the breach on a Friday, notified affected customers the following Monday and reported it to authorities, but did not say how many customers were affected or when the breach occurred.
